usage.message: The input does not match the operation schema.
usage.hint: Run `board schema` to see the expected input and fix the arguments.

recovery.action: Fix the arguments using `board schema`.

wrong_id_kind.message: The ID is valid but names a different kind of object.
wrong_id_kind.hint: Pass the ID kind the operation expects, e.g. B<n> for a block or a task key for a task.

recovery.action: Pass the expected ID kind.

forbidden.message: The caller is not allowed to run this operation on this object.
forbidden.hint: Check which role may run the operation in `board schema`, or ask the operator.

recovery.action: Use an allowed role or ask the operator for access.

not_found.message: The project, task, block, comment or item does not exist.
not_found.hint: Check the ID with `board status` or `board task <KEY>`.

recovery.action: Check the ID and locate the object.

not_implemented.message: This operation is not available in this daemon build.
not_implemented.hint: Ask the operator to update the daemon to a build with this operation.

recovery.action: Update the daemon to a build with this operation.

block_not_open.hint: Read the task with `board task <KEY>` to see the current blocks.

recovery.action: Read the current blocks before choosing another action.

block_still_open.hint: Answer a question with `board answer <BLOCK> <TEXT>`; comment on another block with `board comment <KEY> <TEXT> --block <BLOCK>`.

recovery.action: Answer or comment on the open block instead of following up.

wrong_block_type.message: The operation does not apply to this type of block.
wrong_block_type.hint: Read the block type with `board task <KEY>` and use the operation for that type.

recovery.action: Use the operation for the current block type.

stale_comment_revision.message: The comment has a newer revision than the one acknowledged.
stale_comment_revision.hint: Read the latest comment revision, then acknowledge that revision.

recovery.action: Read the latest comment revision before acknowledging it.

turn_closed.message: The turn is closed: the task was submitted, moved or archived since.
turn_closed.hint: Read your open turns with `board inbox` and act only on a turn listed there.

recovery.action: Read your open turns and act only on a turn listed there.

not_turn_taker.message: This session has not taken the turn.
not_turn_taker.hint: Take the turn with `board inbox ack` first; only the session that took it can submit or return it.

recovery.action: Take the turn first; only the session that took it can submit or return it.

turn_wait_limit.message: The turn has used its waits: the count or the total wait time reached the limit.
turn_wait_limit.hint: Submit or return the turn; the operator gets an inbox item once the wait ends.

recovery.action: Submit or return the turn instead of waiting again.

submit_basis_invalid.message: The submission basis fields are inconsistent.
submit_basis_invalid.hint: Use from and a nonblank reason for carried, a nonblank reason for skipped, and from only with carried.

recovery.action: Correct the basis fields and submit again.

submit_source_not_tested.message: The source has no tested origin on this task.
submit_source_not_tested.hint: Choose a tested submission SHA on this task, or a carried SHA with a tested origin; otherwise test or explicitly skip with a reason.

recovery.action: Choose a source with a tested origin on this task or change the basis.

head_mismatch.message: The commit is not the head GitHub reports for the task's pull request, or a submit by task key found no pull request.
head_mismatch.hint: Push the commit to the task's pull request branch and submit the head GitHub shows.

recovery.action: Push the commit to the task's pull request branch and submit the head GitHub shows.

return_not_allowed.message: A task can be returned to Dev only from a column right of Dev.
return_not_allowed.hint: In Dev, ask with `board ask` instead.

recovery.action: In Dev, ask with a block instead of returning the task.

move_not_allowed.message: The task cannot be corrected to that column.
move_not_allowed.hint: Read why with `board task <KEY> --why`; pick an enabled column, and unlink a merged pull request with `board unlink` first.

recovery.action: Read why the task is where it is; pick an enabled column, and unlink a merged pull request first.

move_outside_todo_group.message: Manual moves require an enabled Todo-group source and destination.
move_outside_todo_group.hint: Pick an enabled Todo-group column; use `board move --correct` to correct a wrong column.

recovery.action: Pick an enabled Todo-group column or correct a wrong column.

work_started.message: Work has started on this task.
work_started.hint: Read `board task <KEY> --why`; resolve the open pull request or live worker before moving idle work.

recovery.action: Resolve the open pull request or live worker before moving idle work.

column_mirrored.message: The column is mirrored from the project tracker.
column_mirrored.hint: Change the task status in the named project tracker instead.

recovery.action: Change the task status in the named project tracker instead.

order_anchor_invalid.message: The order anchor must be another live task in the same column.
order_anchor_invalid.hint: Pick another task from the same column in `board status`, or use `--top` or `--bottom`.

recovery.action: Pick another task from the same column, or place the task at the top or bottom.

task_archived.message: The task is archived, so it cannot change.
task_archived.hint: Ask an operator to add the task to the board again if work continues.

recovery.action: Ask an operator to add the task to the board again if work continues.

link_conflict.message: Another linked pull request prevents this manual link.
link_conflict.hint: Read the task links and use a different task or resolve the existing pull request link.

recovery.action: Read the task links and resolve the blocking pull request.

retry_not_applicable.message: The item is not in a state that can be retried.
retry_not_applicable.hint: Read the item with `board task <KEY>`; close it if it needs no retry.

recovery.action: Read the item and close it if no retry is needed.

idempotency_key_mismatch.message: The idempotency key was already used with a different input.
idempotency_key_mismatch.hint: Use a new key for a new command, or repeat the earlier input with the same key.

recovery.action: Use a new key for new input or repeat the original input.

identity_unavailable.message: The daemon cannot tell who the caller is right now.
identity_unavailable.hint: Ask in your own session, then retry the same command later with its existing idempotency key if it has one.

recovery.action: Ask in your own session, then retry the same command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.
recovery.retryTiming: After caller identity is available; wait briefly between retries.

starting.message: The daemon is still starting; nothing was applied.
starting.hint: Wait until the daemon is ready, then retry the command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.

recovery.action: Wait until the daemon is ready, then retry the command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.
recovery.retryTiming: After the daemon is ready; wait briefly between retries.

stopping.message: The daemon is stopping; nothing was applied.
stopping.hint: Wait until the daemon is running again, then retry the command with its existing idempotency key if it has one; if it stays stopped, ask in your own session.

recovery.action: Wait until the daemon is running again, then retry the command with its existing idempotency key if it has one; if it stays stopped, ask in your own session.
recovery.retryTiming: After the daemon is running again; wait briefly between retries.

github_unavailable.message: GitHub did not confirm current pull request facts.
github_unavailable.hint: Follow the message: ask the operator to fix what it names, or retry a read or link once GitHub answers the board's polls; repeat a submit only by task key in shadow mode.

recovery.action: Ask the operator to fix what the message names; retry a read or link once GitHub answers, and repeat a submit only by task key in shadow mode.
recovery.retryTiming: After GitHub answers the board's polls.

version_mismatch.message: The client and daemon catalog versions do not match; nothing was applied.
version_mismatch.hint: Run `board service restart` to update the daemon, then retry.

recovery.action: Run `board service restart`, then retry the command.

mcp.hint: Restart your agent session so `board mcp` loads the daemon's catalog; if the mismatch remains, run `board service restart`.

recovery.action: Restart your agent session; if the mismatch remains, run `board service restart`. Then retry the tool call.

daemon_unavailable.message: The daemon is not running or cannot be reached; nothing was applied.
daemon_unavailable.hint: Ask in your own session; the operator can check `board service status`, then run `board service restart`, or `board service install` if the service was never installed. Retry the same command with its existing idempotency key if it has one once the daemon is available.

recovery.action: Ask in your own session, then retry the same command with its existing idempotency key if it has one.
recovery.retryTiming: After the daemon is available; wait briefly between retries.

config.message: The configuration is missing or invalid.
config.hint: Fix the configuration file named in the error, then run the command again.

recovery.action: Fix the named configuration file and retry.

mcp.hint: Fix the variable named in `context.environmentVariable` where `board mcp` starts. Only when `context.configPath` is also present, making that config.yaml valid with an `http.port` works instead; `board doctor --offline` names what is wrong in it.

recovery.action: Fix the named variable or config.yaml, restarting your agent session after a variable change, then retry the tool call.

identity_missing.message: No caller identity was found: this is not a Spur session and no .spur-board/token was found walking up from the current folder.
identity_missing.hint: Run the command in a Spur session of a project listed in config.yaml, or run `board token create --name <name> --into <folder>` and ask the operator to approve the request in Slack.

recovery.action: Get a caller identity as the fix says, then run the command again.

service_start_failed.message: The service unit is installed, but the service did not start.
service_start_failed.hint: Read why it failed with `journalctl --user -u spur-board.service -n 100` and run `board doctor`; systemd keeps restarting the service until the cause is fixed.

recovery.action: Fix the cause shown by `journalctl --user -u spur-board.service -n 100` and `board doctor`, then run `board service restart`.

update_rolled_back.message: The update failed, so the board is back on the version it ran before.
update_rolled_back.hint: Fix the cause named in this error, then run `board update` again.

recovery.action: Fix the reported cause, then run `board update` again.

rollback_failed.message: A rollback step failed; the package, database or service may be only partly restored.
rollback_failed.hint: Fix the step named in this error, then run `board rollback --yes` again.

recovery.action: Fix the reported step, then run `board rollback --yes`.

outcome_unknown.message: The connection was lost after the request was sent; it may have been applied.
outcome_unknown.hint: Run the command again with the same idempotency key to learn the outcome.

recovery.action: Check the outcome, then retry with the same idempotency key if needed.
recovery.retryTiming: After checking the outcome, with a short delay.
recovery.outcomeCheck: Read the task or item with `board task <KEY>` before retrying.

unexpected.message: An unexpected failure occurred; the outcome may be unknown.
unexpected.hint: Use the trace reference in the daemon log; repeat reads or check a mutation outcome before retrying with the same key.

recovery.action: Check whether the request took effect. A read-only request can be repeated; for a mutation, retry with the same idempotency key only after checking the outcome.
recovery.retryTiming: After checking a mutation outcome, or after a short delay for a read-only request.
recovery.outcomeCheck: Check the operation result or state before retrying a mutation; a read-only request needs no outcome check.

operations.description: List items, freshness, service health, host metrics, tasks with columnEnteredAt, turns and PRs; detail adds facts.

mcp.name: status_get
mcp.whenToUse: Get a board overview.
mcp.whenNotToUse: Use task_get for one task.

examples.summary: Show the board with full facts and links

project.description: Project to limit the answer to, except sources and services, which always cover every project the caller may see; absent means every project the caller may see.

detail.description: Include full ticket, pull request and session facts; absent means compact rows.

id.description: Item ID: I followed by a number, e.g. I7.

anyOf.description: Task key: a Jira key (PROJ-123) or a GitHub issue (owner/repo#42, or repo#42).

task.description: Task the item is about; null for a board-wide item.

at.description: When the item was raised, ISO 8601 UTC.

summary.description: What needs the operator, in one line.

key.description: Stable key of this actionable item.

unconfirmed.description: Whether a supporting fact is stale or its source is blind.

factAt.description: Time of the supporting fact, when known.

items.description: An actionable item with its freshness mark.
Actionable items in priority order.

warmingUp.description: Whether a source of the requested projects or spur still needs a complete poll.

spurUnavailable.description: One combined Spur availability line, or null when available.

hostLoad.description: Host-load episode line, or null when absent.

sampledAt.description: When the daemon took this sample, ISO 8601 UTC. It samples every 30 seconds; reads never take a new sample, so an old value means sampling is stuck.

cpuPercent.description: Host CPU busy percent over all cores since the previous sample, one decimal; null on the first sample or when unreadable.

availableBytes.description: Host memory available for new work without swapping, in bytes.

usedPercent.description: Percent of host memory in use: total minus available, over total; one decimal.

mount.description: Mount point of the volume: the topmost directory on the same device. A bind mount of the same device shows its parent mount.

totalBytes.description: Size of the volume in bytes, root-reserved blocks included.

availableBytes.description: Free bytes an unprivileged user can still write, without root-reserved blocks.

usedPercent.description: Percent of the volume in use, as df shows it: used over used plus available, without root-reserved blocks; one decimal.

disk.description: The volume closest to running out: the first of volumes, with the least free bytes; null when no volume could be read.

mount.description: Mount point of the volume: the topmost directory on the same device. A bind mount of the same device shows its parent mount.

totalBytes.description: Size of the volume in bytes, root-reserved blocks included.

availableBytes.description: Free bytes an unprivileged user can still write, without root-reserved blocks.

usedPercent.description: Percent of the volume in use, as df shows it: used over used plus available, without root-reserved blocks; one decimal.

volumes.description: Each distinct volume among /, the board data directory and the temp directory, least free bytes first. A volume that cannot be read is left out.

host.description: Host CPU, memory and disk usage from the last sample of the daemon; null before the first sample.

service.description: daemon, github, github-project, jira, spur, or a chat gateway kind such as slack.

state.description: failing: a blind source, a github-project source whose last poll failed, or a gateway that is down; degraded: a source that never completed, is stale, warms up or waits for its rate budget, or a daemon with no completed board tick for over 120 seconds; else healthy. A source service takes its worst source.

since.description: Healthy: since when the service has been usable in this daemon run. That is daemon.startedAt for the daemon, the latest healthySince of its sources for github, github-project, jira and spur, and for a gateway the end of its last recorded outage or daemon.startedAt, whichever is later. Failing gateway: when the outage started. Otherwise null.

lastGoodAt.description: Last sign of work: the last completed board tick for the daemon, the oldest latest observation of its sources for github, github-project, jira and spur (null when one has none); null for a gateway.

reason.description: Why the service is not healthy, from its first worst source for github, jira and spur; null when healthy.

items.description: Health of one service.

services.description: One health row per service: daemon, each chat gateway, then github, github-project (only when a column mirrors a GitHub Project), spur and jira when sources lists one. Daemon and gateway rows are board-wide; source services roll up the sources listed, which cover every project the caller may see whatever project says.

state.description: down while delivery to any space of the gateway is suspended.

since.description: When the earliest outage started, ISO 8601 UTC, or null when up.

reason.description: Reason of the earliest outage, or null when up.

items.description: Transport health of one gateway.

transport.description: Transport health of each chat gateway.

pointsLastHour.description: Reported source points consumed during the preceding hour.

project.description: Board project whose tracker or repository this source polls; null for the shared spur source.

observedAt.description: Time of the latest observation, if any.

lastCompleteAt.description: Time of the latest complete observation.

blindReason.description: Why this source is blind, or null when it is usable.

message.description: Short explanation of the source state.

failure.description: Why the last poll failed, or null after a delivered batch; present only on github-project: sources.

message.description: What the last poll failed on.

remaining.description: Requests or points the source still allowed.

limit.description: Full budget the source restores at reset, or null when it reported none.

resetAt.description: When the source said it restores the full budget.

budget.description: Request budget from the last poll of this source that reported one, or null when none did.

stale.description: Whether facts from this source exceed their freshness threshold.

waitsForBudget.description: Whether the daemon's adapter runner has put off this source's next regular poll for a rate limit: the last regular poll in this daemon run either reported a budget under github.reserveRemaining (GitHub sources, complete or not) or failed as throttled, with or without a retry time (any source), or failed in any other way while the last budget a poll of this run reported, an on-demand refresh included, is under github.reserveRemaining with a future reset (this case also ends at that reset), and the paused poll has not started yet. Held in memory, so false after a restart until a poll pauses again; a stored budget or an on-demand refresh never sets it.

healthySince.description: When this source became usable (not blind) in this daemon run: its first non-blind observation since daemon start or since it was last blind. Stale, warming-up or budget-wait spells that did not make it blind do not move it. Null while blind or before that observation. Resets when the daemon restarts; compare with daemon.startedAt.

warmingUp.description: Whether this source needs a complete poll in this daemon run.

defaultBranch.description: GitHub pull request sources only: the default-branch colour, red when the latest check run of a push-triggered workflow finished without success (failed, cancelled, timed out) or a commit status failed (scheduled and other runs ignored, branch protection not read); null until a poll reads it.

state.description: Colour of the default-branch head.

sha.description: Head commit when this colour was first read; while red, the first red commit.

since.description: When the board first read this colour.

confirmedAt.description: When a poll last read this colour; a poll that reads no colour keeps it.

check.description: Name of the first failing check, or null.

url.description: Web URL of the failing run, or null.

anyOf.description: Colour of the default-branch head. It is red when the latest check run of a push-triggered workflow finished without success (failed, cancelled, timed out) or a commit status failed; scheduled, manual and other runs and check runs outside workflows are ignored, and branch protection is not read.

items.description: Freshness and availability of one source.

sources.description: Freshness and availability of each source of every project the caller may see, whatever project says, with spur first.

key.description: Task key: a Jira key (PROJ-123) or a GitHub issue (owner/repo#42, or repo#42).

project.description: Project the task belongs to.

column.description: Board column the task is in.

membership.description: Whether the task is on the board, outside the tracker filter, or archived.

submission.description: Latest submission; null when none, absent on older servers.

column.description: Column submitted from.

at.description: Submission time, ISO 8601 UTC.

basis.description: Declared testing provenance; tested does not claim tests passed.

from.description: Supplied source SHA for carried work, otherwise null.

testedOrigin.description: Original tested submission SHA for carried work, otherwise null.

reason.description: Literal explanation supplied by the submitter.

voided.description: Whether this submission has been voided for gate purposes.

anyOf.description: Latest accepted submission by row order, including pending and voided submissions.

qaSubmission.description: The QA column's latest submission, pending and voided included; null when none or when the project has no enabled QA column; absent on older servers.

column.description: Column submitted from.

at.description: Submission time, ISO 8601 UTC.

basis.description: Declared testing provenance; tested does not claim tests passed.

from.description: Supplied source SHA for carried work, otherwise null.

testedOrigin.description: Original tested submission SHA for carried work, otherwise null.

reason.description: Literal explanation supplied by the submitter.

voided.description: Whether this submission has been voided for gate purposes.

anyOf.description: Latest accepted submission by row order, including pending and voided submissions.

columnEnteredAt.description: Time the task entered its current real column, ISO 8601 UTC; latest real move or correction, falling back to the original add time, or null if neither is known.

position.description: 1-based place in the column order; new arrivals go last; absent on older servers.

shadowColumn.description: Column the dispatcher works from in shadow mode: where the board would have the task. Present only while the project dispatcher is in shadow mode.

shadowDiffers.description: Whether shadowColumn differs from column. Present only while the project dispatcher is in shadow mode.

state.description: One line: ticket status, pull request states and session counts by health, an ended session counted as `ended (<reason>)`, joined by "; ".

prCount.description: Number of effective pull request links.

openBlocks.description: Number of open blocks on the task.

id.description: Block ID: B followed by a number, e.g. B12.

addressee.description: Who is expected to resolve the block.

session.description: Session the newest block notification for the addressee went to; null for the operator or before assignment.

items.description: One open block.

blocks.description: Open blocks on the task, oldest first, without their text.

returned.description: The return that put the task in Dev. Present only while the task stays in Dev after the return and before its next submit.

from.description: Column the task was returned from.

at.description: When the task was returned, ISO 8601 UTC.

by.description: Who returned the task to Dev.

block.description: The code block the return opened.

findings.description: Number of review findings the return sent; null when not given.

ticket.description: Latest ticket facts, or null before observation. Present only with detail.

trackerId.description: Stable id of the tracker the ticket came from; the same across polls.

id.description: The ticket's stable id in its tracker; unlike the key, it stays the same when the ticket moves to another project.

key.description: Task key: a Jira key (PROJ-123) or a GitHub issue (owner/repo#42, or repo#42).

status.description: Ticket status as the tracker names it.

assignee.description: Who the ticket is assigned to, or null.

inFilter.description: Whether the ticket matched the project's tracker filter; false when it was fetched only by key.

url.description: Web URL of the ticket.

anyOf.description: Facts about one tracker ticket.

prs.description: Latest facts for linked pull requests. Present only with detail.

number.description: Pull request number in the repository.

url.description: Web URL of the pull request.

author.description: Login of the pull request author.

headSha.description: Commit SHA of the head of the pull request.

headBranch.description: Branch name of the head of the pull request.

state.description: Whether the pull request is open, closed or merged.

draft.description: Whether the pull request is a draft.

mergeable.description: Whether the head merges into the base without conflicts.

mergeState.description: Merge state as the source reports it; any value not listed is unknown.

state.description: State of the latest run of this check on the head commit.

completedAt.description: When the latest run finished; null while it runs.

requiredChecks.description: Required checks on the head commit, the latest run of each.

state.description: State of the latest run of this check on the head commit.

completedAt.description: When the latest run finished; null while it runs.

checks.description: All check contexts on the head commit, the latest run of each; the fallback for branches without required checks.

state.description: State of the latest review by this reviewer.

commitSha.description: Commit the review was given on.

reviews.description: The latest review of each reviewer, with the commit it was given on.

resolved.description: Whether the review thread is resolved.

id.description: Node ID of the review thread; missing in facts stored by an earlier version.

url.description: Web URL of the thread's first comment; missing in facts stored by an earlier version.

outdated.description: Whether the thread is on a diff line the head no longer has; missing in facts stored by an earlier version.

reviewThreads.description: Review threads on the pull request.

kind.description: Kind of reviewer asked to review.

id.description: Login of the user or bot, or the slug of the team.

reviewer.description: Login or team name as stored by an earlier version; new facts use kind and id.

asCodeOwner.description: Whether the review was requested because the reviewer owns changed code.

items.description: Task key: a Jira key (PROJ-123) or a GitHub issue (owner/repo#42, or repo#42).

ticketKeys.description: Ticket keys found in the head branch name and the title.

updatedAt.description: When the pull request last changed.

mergedAt.description: When the pull request merged; absent while it is not merged and in facts stored by an earlier version.

closedAt.description: When the pull request closed without merge; absent while it is not closed and in facts stored by an earlier version.

feedback.description: Comments and submitted reviews on the pull request, oldest first, without their text.

kind.description: Whether this is a comment or a submitted review.

id.description: Stable id of the comment or review in the source.

type.description: Whether the author is a user or a bot.

author.description: Who posted it; null for a deleted account.

postedAt.description: When the comment was posted or the review submitted.

state.description: State of this review; missing for a comment and in snapshots written before it.

statusComment.description: True for a status comment of a reviewer service, marked by its last line; it is not external feedback. Missing otherwise.

url.description: Web URL of the comment or review; missing in snapshots and handed entries written before it.

editedAt.description: When it was last edited; for a review the newest edit of its body or its inline comments. Missing when never edited or not yet read.

comments.description: A review's inline comments, thread replies included, oldest first within each thread; missing for a comment and a review without inline comments.

id.description: Stable id of the inline review comment in the source.

url.description: Web URL that opens the inline comment, a thread reply included, in its thread.

threadId.description: Id of the review thread the inline comment belongs to.

editedAt.description: When the inline comment was last edited; missing when never edited.

feedbackComplete.description: Whether feedback holds every comment back to the last one handed over, or to the start of the pull request; missing reads as incomplete.

items.description: Facts about one pull request.

sessions.description: Latest facts for linked sessions. Present only with detail.

id.description: Spur session name.

spurProject.description: Spur project the session belongs to.

branch.description: Git branch the session works on, or null.

number.description: Pull request number in the repository.

pr.description: Pull request linked to the session, or null.

url.description: Published link URL.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle status: a known value or an unknown one kept as is.

health.description: Health state after smoothing: a known value or an unknown one kept as is.

healthSince.description: When the current health value began to hold, as the adapter observed it; health durations count from here.

rateLimitResetAt.description: Known reset time while the session is rate limited; omitted otherwise.

lastActivityAt.description: When the session last showed activity, or null.

endedAt.description: When the session ended, or null while it is live. The adapter supplies it: Spur keeps no end time.

endReason.description: Why the session ended, or null while it is live. Set together with endedAt.

queuedRings.description: Board rings still waiting in the session queue, undelivered. Only board rings are listed, never other queued text; absent when none.

notification.description: Board notification the queued ring belongs to.

ring.description: Ring number within that notification series.

items.description: One board ring waiting in the session queue.

column.description: Board column the turn belongs to.

reason.description: Why the turn was handed to the executor.

returned.description: Always omitted by status.get, even with detail=true; use task.get --why or inbox.get for details.

from.description: Column the task was returned from.

block.description: The code block the return opened.

reason.description: Reason of the return, verbatim from its code block.

reason.description: What the holder waits for, as it gave it.

wakesAt.description: When the board ends the wait and rings the holder, ISO 8601 UTC.

threads.description: Always omitted by status.get, even with detail=true; use task.get --why or inbox.get for details.

id.description: Node ID of the review thread.
